hotspots.title: Edge to edge design
hotspots.text: 360° Bloomwash Pro has a wide edge to edge, one piece glass lid which gives a better and more convenient drum access.

hotspots.title: Hexa Bloom impeller
hotspots.text: The newly designed hexa bloom impeller with 6 vanes, washes clothes in a unique 360° blooming wash motion.

hotspots.title: 3 hot water modes
hotspots.text: Heats water upto 60° C at 3 different levels ranging from Warm, Hot to Allergen Free, offering customized care by offering different water temperatures as per cloth type.

hotspots.title: Removes up to 48 hours old stains
hotspots.text: No need to worry about immediate removal of stains. With the Stainwash program, one can remove stains that are even 48 hours old.
